# WR-WATER v0.2 — IUS pressure-zone network (generated by tools/make_network_md.mjs)

Status: **real** = value taken from the cited public document; est = training estimate (method in the note). Zone demand weights are real relative shares from the cited tables; the sim scales them so the IUS total equals 2025 actual production, so absolute zone demands are estimates built on real shares.
